## Specific task description

Task instruction: Lift the black laptop fitting laptop bags using the right arm.

Task description: Use the right arm to lift open the black top cover of the notebook at the center of the table, rotating it further around the hinge. The cover is already slightly open and is the movable part to operate.

Success criteria: Open the lid from its minimum opening to at least forty percent of its movable range while keeping the right end effector near the laptop's specified interaction point. Opening the lid while moving the end effector away does not count.

## Execution tips

- Prefer the free edge of the top cover away from the hinge, at a point with enough contact area for the pads. This reduces the chance of catching the hinge or slipping after gripping only a corner.
- Adjust the gripper opening to the lid thickness and clearance beneath it. Before closing, check that the fingers are on opposite sides of the lid; avoid relying on image overlap or accidentally gripping the base as well.
- When lifting the lid, follow its rotation around the hinge by adjusting the end-effector pose. Avoid pulling rigidly along a straight line, which could jam or lose contact.
